DynamicTemplateString.SourceText: * Context ( task ) * * Generates a JSON context document for AI script generation. * Run from the layout where you want the AI to compose a script. * * Parameter: * task - Text description of what script to create * e.g. "Create a script to add a new line item to the current invoice" * * Returns: JSON string matching the CONTEXT.json schema used by agentic-fm * * Output includes: * solution - file name * task - the provided description * current_layout - name, id, base table occurrence * tables - all TOs referenced on the current layout with complete field lists * ddl - GetTableDDL output (includes FOREIGN KEY relationships and field comments) * scripts - all scripts in the file (name + id) * layouts - all layouts in the file (name + id) * value_lists - all value lists (name + id + source) * layout_objects - named objects on the current layout * * Requires: FileMaker Pro 21.0+ * * Note: Relationship data comes from the ddl section via GetTableDDL's FOREIGN KEY output. * Both sides of a relationship must be in the TO list for the FK to appear in the DDL. * See: https://help.claris.com/en/pro-help/content/schema-best-practices-for-sql-generation.html
